description: This file defines a controller class `ProjectActivityReportController` within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Time plugin module. It manages preparing data and properties for the 'project-activity-report' component, based on incoming HTTP request parameters. The class inherits from an abstract Vue controller and uses traits to access project services.

classes.name: ProjectActivityReportController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing project activity report data to be rendered by Vue component, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties derived from request query parameters, such as date range, project details, and timesheet inclusion filter.
